sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Dangerous Goods UN38.3 Drop Testing and CE-RED Electromagnetic Lab

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage, codified by Samoan statutes)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)
Samoa–New Zealand Double Taxation Agreement (concluded 2010, in force 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (Samoa); Proceeds of Crime Act 2018; International Companies Act 2012 (as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018) and Beneficial Ownership Regulations 2018; administered by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the Registrar of International Companies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin (or equivalent legal authority)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Hague Apostille not applicable — Samoa is not a contracting state)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or financial institution in the country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter from a recognized global financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing financial institution (e.g., HSBC, Citi, Standard Chartered)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Curriculum vitae or professional qualification evidence for the proposed director (for a safety-testing laboratory regulated activity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independent attestation by the director or issuing professional body

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorised signatories against (i) the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic PEP and politically exposed person datasets, (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated List, (iii) the US Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, and (iv) the Commonwealth/regional sanctions lists. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, family members, and close associates, and for any source of funds emanating from a high-risk jurisdiction under FATF recommendations. Independent verification of identity must be conducted using reliable, government-issued documents; electronic verification may be supplemented with physical copies.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) - International Company Registry Online (e-searching and name reservation portal)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All registered names must be in Latin script (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, plus limited punctuation such as ampersand, apostrophe, comma, dash, period). A secondary name in non-Latin characters (e.g., Chinese) may be recorded as a trade-name alias, but the Latin-script name is the sole official registered name. If the proposed name is in Chinese characters, a Latin-script transliteration must be submitted and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Registrar of International Companies rejects a proposed name, the applicant may file a written administrative appeal within 14 days of the rejection notice, pursuant to Section 24(3) of the International Companies Act 2012. The appeal must set out the grounds and may include evidence of consent from the relevant Samoan regulatory authority for any sensitive token (e.g., Central Bank of Samoa for 'Bank'). If the Registrar denies the appeal, the applicant may escalate to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour within 30 days of the denial. The applicant may concurrently submit a revised name for reservation. Name reservations are valid for 30 days and may be extended by a further 30-day period upon payment of the prescribed fee and submission of a written extension request.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for the holding/contracting entity if the registered agent in Samoa provides a physical street address and assumes statutory responsibility for service of process. However, because the scope of business includes dangerous goods UN38.3 drop testing and CE-RED electromagnetic testing, the International Company must hold or coordinate a physical testing lab (operational subsidiary or licensed third party) outside Samoa; the Samoan-registered entity will be a holding and contracting vehicle only. The registered agent's address may serve as the registered office, but it cannot be used for actual laboratory operations. Full commercial substance will be assessed against the OECD/Global Forum criteria, and a low-risk substance profile will apply if the entity solely conducts mobile/site testing contracts outside Samoa.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 15% annual risk of an unannounced physical inspection by the Registrar of International Companies or the Samoa Police Service, triggered by AML/CFT risk signals, regulatory complaints, or scheduled compliance audits. For a safety-testing laboratory, a separate Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) or Ministry of Health inspection may occur if any testing activity is physically performed within Samoan territory.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name reservation and clearance search (per proposed name)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee under the International Companies (Registration and Miscellaneous Fees) Regulations 2013

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation duty and registration fee for International Company (minimum capital; no authorised capital threshold)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee per International Companies (Registration and Miscellaneous Fees) Regulations; flat rate for ordinary incorporated company

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent's office address and corporate services (annual) - basic service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for Samoan registered agents, typically between USD 400 and USD 800 per annum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of constituent documents (per batch up to 4 documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in country of origin plus Samoan High Commission/consulate (or authorised legalisation agent)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for legalisation chain without apostille; varies between USD 300 and USD 400 per batch

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: External counsel professional fee for Stage 1 due diligence, name clearance, and UBO verification
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed fee per corporate formation engagement, benchmarked at USD 700 - USD 900 in the Samoan market

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2009 and 2015, ss. 5–10 (Incorporation), s. 34 (Registered Office), s. 62 (Appointment of Directors), Part VII (Annual Fees); read together with the Companies Act 2001 (Samoa) only where expressly incorporated.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Company (Form IC-1) together with Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital is required for a Samoa International Company; share capital is fixed by the subscriber in the Memorandum of Association. No escrow account, capital deposit, or proof of funds is mandated by the International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Company, as submitted to the Registrar of International Companies, be and are hereby adopted and ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER that the allotment and issue of subscribed shares to the subscriber be and is hereby ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office of the Company be established in Apia, Samoa, as stated in the application for incorporation. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Name] be appointed Director, [Name] as Company Secretary, and [Name] as Finance Officer until resignation or removal. RESOLVED FURTHER that the Directors be authorized to open bank accounts, appoint a licensed jurisdiction agent, and execute all statutory filings, including tax-exemption documentation with the Ministry of Revenue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) Registry – online e-Registry portal or via a licensed international company service provider
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three ranked proposed corporate names through the licensed agent. The Registrar searches the International Companies Register and the domestic company index maintained by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) for exact or confusingly similar matches. Approved names are reserved for 30 days pending filing of the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of each subscriber and proposed director
Cover letter from the licensed international company agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected as undesirable or too similar to an existing entity, submit alternative names within 5 business days or file a written request for administrative review with SIFA; the reservation may be renewed once upon payment of the renewal fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA Registry – Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1, accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association executed by the subscriber and countersigned by the licensed IC agent. The application must designate the registered office in Samoa, the issued share structure, and the initial director(s). Electronic submission through the SIFA e-Registry is accepted; wet-ink originals must be retained by the agent for at least 7 years.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (English language)
Consent to Act as Licensed Registered Agent
Registered Office Address Confirmation in Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a notice of deficiency or query, the licensed agent has 14 days to file corrective documentation; failure to cure results in deemed withdrawal, but paid fees may be re-applied once to a fresh application within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Statutory Registration Fees and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon acceptance of the application, pay the USD 250 incorporation fee by wire transfer to the SIFA designated government bank account or in person at the Treasury collection point. The e-Registry generates an electronic receipt, after which the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, which is conclusive evidence of incorporation as of the registration date.
required_dossiers: Treasury payment receipt or wire transfer confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If issuance is delayed beyond the service standard, the licensed agent may escalate in writing to the Registrar for expedition; a lost or damaged certificate is re-issued upon submission of an affidavit of loss and payment of the replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Appointment of Officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Directors of the International Company; minutes retained at the registered office in Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a written resolution to adopt the constitutional documents, ratify the share subscription, fix the registered office, appoint the initial Director(s), Company Secretary, and Finance Officer, and authorize banking arrangements and engagement of the licensed jurisdiction agent. Resolutions must be entered in the statutory minute book.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (written minutes or circular resolution)
Consent to Act as Director and Company Secretary
Registered office service agreement with licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a procedural defect is identified, pass a ratification resolution at the next board meeting; any vacated office must be filled and notified to SIFA within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Ancillary Statutory Registrations and Tax-Exempt Confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Revenue (Samoa); MCIL Licensing Authority; Samoa Bureau of Standards (SBS); Accident Compensation Corporation (ACC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply to the Ministry of Revenue for confirmation of the International Company's non-resident tax-exempt status under the Income Tax Act 2012 (Samoa). Obtain the MCIL Business Licence for scientific and technical testing services, register the laboratory with SBS for scoped testing activities under the Standards and Quality Act 2016, and complete ACC workplace registration. All certifications must reference the Certificate of Incorporation and current annual fee receipt.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Good Standing / current annual fee receipt from SIFA
SBS laboratory notification and testing scope schedule
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any agency issues a query, submit supplementary test-method documentation (e.g., UN38.3 Manual of Tests and Procedures excerpts) within 15 working days; if tax exemption is denied, an objections hearing is available under the Tax Administration Act 2012 (Samoa).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) Licensing Authority, in coordination with the Samoa Bureau of Standards (SBS)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence – Scientific and Technical Testing Services (Business Licences Act 1998, Samoa); Laboratory Notification and Scoped Accreditation under the Standards and Quality Act 2016 (Samoa)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) – Planning and Urban Management Agency, Environmental Impact Assessment Unit
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Environmental Registration (low-impact commercial laboratory; no full EIA Report required, but an Environmental Registration Application and Waste Management Plan must be approved before commissioning)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Laboratory wastewater: pH 6–9, BOD5 ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L before discharge to an approved sewer system. Air emissions: battery test chambers and fume hoods must maintain VOC and acid-mist concentrations below workplace exposure standards (50 ppm CO equivalent, 0.1 mg/m³ lead fume). Spent electrolytes and damaged UN38.3 test cells are classified as hazardous waste under the Waste Management Regulations 2013 (Samoa) and must be manifested, stored in UN-approved containers, and transported only by an MNRE-licensed handler; landfilling of spent electrolytes is prohibited.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) following inspection of the laboratory's fire suppression system, thermal-runaway containment area, and emergency egress routes; structural load clearance from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure (MWTI) confirming the floor loading capacity for the drop-test rig; occupational safety registration with the MCIL Occupational Safety and Health Division under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 2006 (Samoa), including a workplace risk assessment for high-speed impact testing and lithium battery handling.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue, Government of Samoa (Inland Revenue and Samoa Customs Service); official portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) obtains its statutory identifier as follows: (1) incorporate under the International Companies Act 1987 via the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) as registrar; (2) automatically acquire a Certificate of Incorporation, which carves out the statutory tax-exempt status; (3) where the IC nevertheless undertakes local economic activity, apply to the Ministry for Revenue for a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) using the prescribed registration form and supporting constitutional documents; (4) register for VAGST separately if annual taxable turnover reaches or exceeds the statutory threshold. For purely exempt offshore holding/testing-service entities, a TIN is required only for filing or voluntary compliance purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists under Samoan law. International Companies are automatically and perpetually exempt from income tax and stamp duty under the International Companies Act 1987. A voluntary VAGST registration election is available for businesses below the compulsory threshold. No hybrid-mismatch or deemed-partnership elective regimes have been enacted that would apply to an IC.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST - Value Added Goods and Services Tax (Goods and Services Tax Act 2008)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WS$100,000 annual taxable turnover (compulsory); voluntary registration permitted for suppliers below the threshold
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None - Samoa does not mandate real-time fiscal clearance, government e-invoicing APIs, or digital stamping. Taxpayers must issue VAGST tax invoices containing prescribed particulars, retain full accounting and source documentation, and file periodic returns through the Ministry for Revenue's tax portal or prescribed filing channels.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (a) goods physically exported from Samoa, and (b) services supplied to a non-resident recipient for use entirely outside Samoa, including laboratory testing services such as UN38.3 battery safety testing and CE-RED electromagnetic testing, provided the supplier retains contemporaneous documentation proving the export or the offshore delivery of the service.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods
Commercial invoice and VAGST zero-rated tax invoice
Signed service contract / testing work order showing the overseas recipient and offshore enjoyment where services are zero-rated
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by a Samoan licensed bank evidencing receipt of the foreign consideration
Test certificates / laboratory reports confirming performance of the testing services in Samoa
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Tax Administration Act 2012 and the Goods and Services Tax Act 2008 empower the Ministry for Revenue to audit zero-rating claims retrospectively; failure to substantiate export or offshore-service status within the statutory record-keeping period exposes the taxpayer to clawback of the zero-rated input tax credits, shortfall penalties of up to 150% of the tax shortfall, statutory interest, and criminal prosecution with fines up to WS$500,000 and/or imprisonment for fraudulent or reckless conduct.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) — The sole monetary, financial, and exchange-control authority for Samoa, administering the Exchange Control Act, the Central Bank of Samoa Act, and the Money Laundering Prevention Act.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan tālā (WST) is materially convertible for current international transactions under Samoa's IMF Article VIII commitments. Capital account transactions, including non-resident borrowing, portfolio investment, and physical currency movement, require prior CBS approval or an exemption certificate. Non-resident International Companies (ICs) holding approved foreign-currency accounts may transfer capital and dividends freely, provided the funds do not enter the local WST banking system except through an authorized dealer. Profit remittance from a Samoan-source business requires a tax clearance certificate from the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA), audited financial statements, and evidence of settlement of annual international company fees.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: All export receipts from goods and services must be repatriated to Samoa within 30 days from the invoice date, unless CBS grants an exemption on justified commercial grounds. Receipts into a resident operating account are subject to a statutory 25% mandatory conversion to WST at an authorized dealer, with the balance retainable in foreign currency. An International Company licensed as non-resident and maintaining a designated offshore foreign-currency account is exempt from the mandatory conversion ratio and may retain 100% of export proceeds in USD, EUR, or AUD, subject to quarterly submission of export proceeds declarations to CBS.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Non-Resident Foreign Currency Account / Operational WST Account
Offshore USD Transaction Account / WST Escrow Account
Commercial Operational Account / Restricted Foreign Currency Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: LOW as a primary clearing rail; MEDIUM as a supplementary disbursement channel. Samoa does not maintain a fintech e-money institution (EMI) or digital-bank licensing framework; therefore Wise, Revolut, and similar offshore EMIs cannot hold a Central Bank settlement account in Samoa or clear WST independently. Such institutions must route through a licensed Samoan commercial bank under an agency or white-label arrangement, and any money service activity directed at Samoan residents triggers CBS registration, AML/CFT obligations, and Financial Intelligence Unit reporting. Consequently, the WS_IC may use Wise for low-value operational disbursements via visa-Mastercard virtual cards or remittance to supplier banks, but it must maintain a conventional correspondent banking tier for all regulated treasury transactions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors are not statutorily required to appear physically in Samoa for account opening; however, the licensed bank's AML/CFT policy imposes a de facto requirement of at least one live video interview with the ultimate beneficial owner or the company secretary, together with notarized/consular-certified passport copies, a certified board resolution, and the original Certificate of Incorporation from the Samoa Registrar of International Companies. For a professional-introducer arrangement administered by a licensed offshore service provider, the physical-presence requirement can be waived entirely under the bank's risk-based customer due diligence procedures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore IC with nominee shareholders, bearer-share structure, or dormant ownership registered at a licensed agent.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed nominee declaration; certified register of directors and members; complete direct-and-indirect beneficial-ownership chart; notarized passport copies of natural-person owners; CRS self-certification; Samoan international company standing certificate; letter from the licensed trustee confirming nil bearer instruments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business scope of high-risk/certified battery safety testing does not correspond to visible physical assets in Samoa.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation certificate; UN38.3 test report template; CE-RED notified-body designation; laboratory equipment lease or ownership proof; professional indemnity insurance; detailed service agreements with lithium-battery manufacturers; curriculum vitae of technical signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Nil/local-tax residency triggers shell-company red flags or negative press from correspondent banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SRA tax exemption certificate for the International Company; economic-substance statement showing outsourced or real laboratory operations; audited or accountant-compiled financial statements; board minutes of actual trading decisions; bank references from countries where testing services are procured.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound shareholder capital arriving from multiple intermediary jurisdictions without transparent audit trail.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth letters from all equity contributors; 24-month bank statements of the remitting entities; SWIFT MT103 confirmation of the traceable original wire; group holding chart; tax clearance or nil-tax certificate from each contributor's competent authority; board-approved capital injection resolution.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be wired via SWIFT MT103 to the IC's designated non-resident foreign-currency account at Bank of South Pacific (Samoa) or ANZ Bank (Samoa), using CBS balance-of-payments classification for direct investment in a non-resident entity and including the corporate enterprise ID `WS_IC_ISIC_7120_02_CAPITAL`. The remitting bank must be an LEI-registered financial institution; the remitter's source of funds must be pre-verified by the Samoan receiving bank. If the capital is subsequently converted to WST for local operating expenditure, the conversion must be executed through an authorized dealer using a CBS-approved spot trade and reported on the CBS Exchange Control Return; no physical notes or bearer instruments may be shipped for IC capitalization.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The WS_IC shall execute outbound trade settlements through two interoperable clearing rails: (i) ordinary operational disbursements using SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers for testing supplies, freight, calibration services, and licensed software; and (ii) high-value laboratory equipment procurement using an irrevocable, confirmed letter of credit compliant with ICC UCP600, with SWIFT MT798/MT799 messaging and reimbursements through the issuing bank's correspondent account. All cross-border dollar, euro, and Australian-dollar payments terminate through the Samoan bank's prime correspondent, typically BSP Australia/VanTimized or ANZ Melbourne. Domestic WST-denominated payments above the CET threshold are settled through the Central Bank's interbank settlement system, with the FX contract evidenced by a CBS-approved onward cover.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore FX forward contracts (both outright and cash-settled) between the IC and an authorized Samoan dealing bank, with a maximum ten-or of 12 months and CBS Form FX-14 reporting of the underlying UN38.3 testing contracts.
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on USD/WST for non-resident ICs sking on a bank-customer basis, provided the underlying exposure is documented through the testing-lab invoice book.
Cross-currency swaps (USD/WST) for long-term conversion of IC capital held offshore into operational WST cash-flow for equipment leases, subject to CBS capital-account approval.
Plain-vanilla currency options (maturity ≤ 6 months) to hedge bid risk and quote risk on multi-year battery safety test proposals, without exercising leverage.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual licence fee for Samoa International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs 10% surcharge per month or part-month; continued non-payment beyond 3 months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 1987.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered agent annual confirmation of registered particulars and beneficial ownership data
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed together with annual fee by 31 May; share transfer updates to beneficial ownership register required within 14 days of change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may constitute an offence under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) regime and can lead to penalty notices and strike-off proceedings.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard International Company; statutory audit is mandatory only for SIFA-licensed international banks, insurance companies, and managed funds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS; a Samoa International Company may maintain financial records under International Financial Reporting Standards or another recognised international standard; local Samoa GAAP does not apply to international companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must maintain a current beneficial ownership register at the Samoa registered office and confirm it annually to SIFA; any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded promptly and reflected in the next annual confirmation.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (standard resident company rate under the Income Tax Act 2012, as amended; qualifying International Companies face an effective 0% rate)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% for a qualifying Samoa International Company (IC): full statutory exemption under section 229 of the International Companies Act 1987, as amended; exemption covers all foreign-source income and capital gains; no Samoan dividend withholding tax; no estate or wealth taxes; GST/VAGST (15%) does not apply to offshore B2B testing revenues provided no taxable supply is made in Samoa

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: SRA Annual Company Income Tax Return (Form IT-1) e-filed via the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) Online Tax Portal; an exempt IC also files an annual declaration/return with the Registrar of International Companies through its licensed registered agent
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (income tax); provisional tax instalments are quarterly only where taxable Samoan-source income exists; GST/VAGST returns are not applicable to an exempt offshore IC; IC Annual Return to the Registrar is due each year on the incorporation anniversary
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual income tax return due within six months after the income year end (e.g., 31 December year end to 30 June of the following year); IC annual return and annual government fee due within 30 days of each incorporation anniversary

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, IC registration number, and SRA Tax Identification Number (TIN)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact name appearing on the Certificate of Incorporation; obtain the Samoan TIN via the registered agent before filing

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income year covered by the return
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Normally the calendar year; align with the IC's financial statements and bank records

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total gross income from all sources
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt IC: enter zero unless any Samoan-source income has been derived

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoan-source income (testing fees invoiced to Samoan clients or physically performed in Samoa)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-zero entry invalidates the ICA 1987 tax exemption and exposes the IC to 27% CIT; treat any such entry as a fatal red flag requiring full disclosure

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign-source income (memorandum item) - e.g., UN38.3 and CE-RED testing fees from overseas clients
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report as exempt income; maintain contracts, certificates, and wire evidence proving place of supply and absence of Samoan economic activity
Deductions are relevant only against Samoan-source taxable income; an exempt IC with zero taxable income claims no deductions
Must be zero for a qualifying IC; a positive balance is assessed at 27%
Computed only if Box 7 is positive; attach a reconciliation schedule for any adjustment

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits: provisional tax paid, foreign withholding tax credits, and prior overpayments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exempt ICs normally have no credits; if credits exceed liability, a refund claim requires a Samoan bank account and SRA verification
Any balance must be settled by the statutory due date; late settlement attracts monthly surcharges

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Director or registered agent signature and certification of true and complete information
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A knowingly false declaration exposes signatories to shortfall penalties, personal restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment up to 5 years

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fixed penalty per month of default expressed in statutory penalty units (currently WST 100 per unit) plus continued accrual until filed; late payment: surcharge of 1.5% per month on the unpaid tax; understatement: shortfall penalty of up to 200% of the tax avoided plus interest; criminal tax evasion: fines up to 200 penalty units and/or imprisonment up to 5 years; repeated non-filing of the IC Annual Return leads to deregistration and freezing of bank accounts

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - Samoa does not impose withholding tax on dividends; dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders are paid gross with no Samoan tax leakage
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No dividend WHT exists, so no DTA relief is required for dividends. For interest and royalties, the non-resident recipient must obtain a Certificate of Residence (TRC) from its home tax authority and submit it with a beneficial-ownership declaration (Form WHT-T) to the Samoa Revenue Authority through the Samoan payer before or at the time of payment; the reduced treaty rate applies only with the TRC and SRA acceptance. Principal treaty: Samoa-China DTA (in force 2013); non-treaty residents bear the 15% statutory rates
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 15% on gross interest and 15% on gross royalties paid to non-residents (Income Tax Act 2012); under the Samoa-China DTA, both interest and royalties may be reduced to 10%, subject to beneficial ownership and TRC; payments for testing-protocol licensing and technical know-how must be structured and documented to avoid recharacterization as royalties

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory monetary threshold in Samoan Tala (WST) is prescribed for Local File or Master File; the Income Tax Act 2012 applies the arm's length principle to all related-party dealings of resident taxpayers, and the SRA may demand contemporaneous documentation on audit. Exempt ICs are outside the CIT net but must still substantiate cross-border intercompany pricing; a practical internal threshold of WST 1,000,000 of related-party turnover is recommended for maintaining a full TP file
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa does not maintain OECD/EU-style Economic Substance Regulations for International Companies; the ICA 1987 exemption is preserved only if the IC (i) does not derive Samoan-source income, (ii) maintains a registered office and licensed registered agent in Samoa, (iii) holds current registers of members, directors, and beneficial owners at the registered office, and (iv) pays the annual IC fee. Foreign shareholders remain subject to home-jurisdiction CFC, controlled-company, and Pillar Two rules; Samoa was removed from the EU list of non-cooperative jurisdictions in October 2023 and maintains TIEAs for information exchange

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misuse of International Company Tax Exemption (de facto Shell Company with Samoan-source activity)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the UN38.3 drop-testing and CE-RED electromagnetic laboratory on Samoan soil for Samoan-resident clients, invoicing Samoan-source testing fees through the IC, while continuing to claim the ICA 1987 full exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of exempt status retrospectively; assessment at 27% CIT on all Samoan-source income; shortfall penalty of up to 200% of the tax avoided; monthly late-payment surcharge of 1.5%; cancellation of the IC by the Registrar of International Companies
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who certified false exempt status are jointly and severally liable for restitution of unpaid tax and penalties, may be disqualified from acting as directors, subjected to travel bans, and prosecuted for tax evasion carrying imprisonment up to 5 years

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False or Misleading Declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly concealing Samoan-source revenue, forging Certificates of Residence, backdating invoices to disguise local testing income as offshore income, or submitting a materially false Form IT-1 declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Shortfall penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded plus interest at 1.5% per month; criminal fines up to 200 penalty units (WST 20,000) and/or imprisonment up to 5 years; asset seizure and bank account freezing under the Tax Administration Act 2012
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil may be pierced for fraud: directors and the registered agent are jointly and severally liable for evaded tax and penalties; professional disqualification, international travel bans, and custodial sentences apply

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining nominee shareholders, failing to disclose the beneficial owner to the licensed registered agent, or using the IC as a conduit to move third-party funds without AML/KYC checks, including layering proceeds of crime through the testing-fee receivables
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 (as amended): fines up to WST 1,000,000 for bodies corporate and WST 500,000 for individuals; forfeiture orders; freezing of bank accounts; deregistration of the IC and revocation of the agent's license
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors knowingly involved in money laundering face imprisonment up to 14 years, travel bans, confiscation of personal assets, and personal liability for the laundered amounts

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Director Governance Failure / Trading While Struck Off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the IC Annual Return or pay the annual government fee for three consecutive years, resulting in strike-off, while the company continues to contract with foreign clients and receive wire payments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar strike-off; corporate bank account frozen; contracts entered after strike-off are void; restoration requires payment of all arrears, reinstatement fees, and SRA compliance clearances
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for all debts incurred while the company was struck off; disqualification orders prevent acting as a director of any Samoa company; continued trading after strike-off is a criminal offence punishable by fines and imprisonment
